## What changed?

Describe the scoped change and link any related issue or approved request.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build` passes, including privacy audits.
- [ ] English and Chinese content are consistent where applicable.
- [ ] Public academic facts and publication metadata were checked against sources.
- [ ] Layout or interaction changes were checked on desktop and mobile in relevant themes.
- [ ] No private data, unpublished material, or unlicensed assets were added.

Add screenshots or notes only when they help reviewers verify the change.
